name: Ловля фігури (2)
description: Chess pieces rely on mobility to perform offensive and defensive tasks effectively. Itâs often said that you can judge who has the better position by looking at the mobility of their pieces. A piece with limited mobility not only contributes less to the game but also runs the risk of being trapped! By confining a low-mobility piece, you can secure material advantage.

examples.text: Which piece is vulnerable? The black rook! With a clever bishop move, White wins material.
The black pieces are active, but after a clever pawn move, the black bishop suddenly becomes the target.
